subject.title: fix(agent): classify stuck recovery as idle timeout

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's phase-aware stuck-recovery boundary, where active model-call stalls can use idle-timeout fallback but side-effecting tool stalls and stale recovery remain non-replay paths?
rationale: The code now matches the requested shape, but the replay boundary affects session-state safety and availability semantics after diagnostic recovery.

options.title: Accept phase-aware boundary

options.title: Require stricter proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until broader runtime proof covers more model-call, tool-call, stale recovery, and reply-run fallback paths against the latest main.

options.title: Pause for recovery timing
options.body: Hold or close this PR if PR #98580 becomes the canonical fix for the same user-facing stuck-session path.
